# CalStudio

> > CalStudio is a no-code platform for building, deploying, and monetizing custom AI applications using GPT-4, GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, and other leading language models.

CalStudio enables creators and businesses to build branded AI chatbots and voice apps without coding, with features including custom domain deployment, Stripe payment integration, and access to 100+ AI models through OpenRouter. The platform supports enterprise use cases with HIPAA-compliant configurations and multi-model AI agent development.

## Key Topics

- Custom GPTs
- No-code AI development
- GPT-4 and GPT-5
- Claude 3 and Claude Sonnet 4
- AI monetization with Stripe
- Custom domain deployment
- Anthropic AI models
- Google Gemini
- OpenRouter API
- Chatbot builders
- Voice apps and text-to-speech
- Educational AI tutors
- HIPAA-compliant AI
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- xAI Grok 4

## Platform Overview

- [CalStudio | Login](https://calstudio.com/dashboard): Login portal for CalStudio voice app and conversational AI platform
- [CalStudio | Create and Launch Custom AI apps without code](https://calstudio.com/services/monetization): No-code AI app creation with Stripe monetization for Claude 4 and GPT-5

## Monetization & Deployment

- [How to Monetize Your Custom GPT & GPT-5](https://calstudio.com/monetize-gpt): Monetize Custom GPTs and GPT-5 with subscriptions and payment integration
- [How to Publish Your Custom GPT to a Custom Domain](https://calstudio.com/custom-domain): Deploy Custom GPT bots to your domain without signup requirements
- [How to Publish Your Custom GPT to a Custom Domain | Complete Guide 2025](https://calstudio.com/blog/publish-custom-gpt-domain): Step-by-step Custom GPT deployment guide with DNS configuration tutorial
- [How to Monetize a Custom Grok 4 AI App](https://calstudio.com/monetize-grok4): Build and monetize xAI Grok 4 apps with subscriptions and payments
- [איך למכור GPT מותאם אישית בישראל | תמיכה בשקלים ₪](https://calstudio.com/monetize-gpt-israel): Hebrew guide: monetize Custom GPTs in Israel with ILS and Stripe support

## AI Model Tutorials

- [How to Create a Custom GPT Using Claude Sonnet 4](https://calstudio.com/claude-sonnet-4): Build and monetize chatbots with Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 4 model
- [How to Build a Custom GPT with Claude 3 | Complete Guide 2025](https://calstudio.com/blog/build-custom-gpt-claude-3): Build and monetize Claude 3 AI assistants using CalStudio no-code platform
- [How to Build a Custom GPT with Gemini 3 Pro](https://calstudio.com/gemini-3-pro): Create AI chatbots with Google's Gemini 3 Pro advanced reasoning model
- [How to Build a Custom GPT with Qwen 3 (Qwen3-Coder) - No Code Required](https://calstudio.com/qwen3-chatbot): No-code guide to build Qwen 3 chatbots with Alibaba's Qwen3-Coder model
- [How to Build Custom AI Apps with OpenRouter Multi-Model API](https://calstudio.com/openrouter-ai): Access 100+ AI models via OpenRouter unified API with CalStudio platform
